faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All conversion happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: Can I copy the HTML code?
faq.answer: Yes. You can copy the generated HTML table code to use in your web pages or documents.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: It works best with flat JSON arrays. Nested objects will be displayed as JSON strings in the table cells.

faq.question: Can I convert large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

faq.question: What is the difference between this and JSON to CSV?
faq.answer: JSON to Table creates an HTML table view for visual display. JSON to CSV creates a downloadable CSV file for spreadsheet applications.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON to HTML table and get the code?
faq.answer: Yes. This free online tool acts as a json html table generator — paste your JSON array and convert json to html table instantly. You can copy the generated HTML code for use in your web projects.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有转换在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。

faq.question: 可以复制 HTML 代码吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以复制生成的 HTML 表格代码，用于网页或文档。

faq.question: 支持嵌套 JSON 对象吗？
faq.answer: 最适合扁平的 JSON 数组。嵌套对象会在表格单元格中显示为 JSON 字符串。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。

faq.question: 这个工具和 JSON 转 CSV 有什么区别？
faq.answer: JSON 转表格创建 HTML 表格视图用于可视化显示。JSON 转 CSV 创建可下载的 CSV 文件用于电子表格应用。
